body.statement: Under the recursive IV-plus-proxy factorization and conditions (i)--(iii) of Kawakami (2021), Theorem 1, the four joint probabilities of the binary potential-outcome types are identified.  The proof on pages 12135--12137 recovers the treatment-conditional response-type weights by simultaneous linear equations, and these weights determine PN and PS.

source.locator: Theorem 1, page 12134, and its proof, pages 12135--12137

attestation.note: Checked against the AAAI publisher PDF at Theorem 1 and the simultaneous-equation proof.
